subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the three guard fixes and exact-head checks pass, should the credential-bearing and code-scanning action revisions be accepted as one grouped update?
rationale: Automated checks can verify integration, but they cannot decide whether OpenClaw accepts the reviewed upstream code that executes with repository credentials and security permissions.

options.title: Approve repaired group
options.body: Land the grouped bump after guard synchronization, green exact-head checks, and security-owner review of the upstream revisions.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate token, registry/build, Codex, and CodeQL revisions into smaller updates for independent security review.

options.title: Defer the group
options.body: Postpone the grouped update if the combined privileged dependency review is not tractable.

recommendation.title: Approve repaired group
recommendation.body: Land the grouped bump after guard synchronization, green exact-head checks, and security-owner review of the upstream revisions.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the most security-sensitive changed workflows to this team.
